topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and contextualises cancer biology across different clinical and scientific disciplines.

topics.label: Biological foundations and experimental modeling of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe cancer as a progressive failure of genetic regulation, cellular differentiation, and tissue architecture, while addressing the methods and challenges of modeling these phenomena in vitro.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and the benign-to-malignant spectrum
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tumors progress from contained, benign growths to invasive and metastatic malignancies, highlighting key histological features and clinical implications.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and classification systems
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic defines the standard naming conventions and clinical exceptions used to classify tumors based on their cell lineage and malignant potential.

topics.label: Pathophysiological causes of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the mechanical, metabolic, and systemic mechanisms through which primary and metastatic tumors cause debilitating disease and death.

topics.label: Comparative oncology and cancer incidence across taxa
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze patterns of cancer frequency and tumor types across human populations, domestic animals, and diverse multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Clinical symptoms and cancer screening strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the rationale, histological basis, and diagnostic efficacy of screening methods used to detect early-stage and premalignant lesions.

topics.label: Lecture closing and housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic concludes the session by referencing the learning outcomes and providing logistical instructions for upcoming practicals and lectures.
